texts.zh-Hans: 我找到一把屋顶那么大的扇子，风一来，我先替它扇了两下。
texts.en: I found a fan as big as a roof. When the breeze came, I fanned it back.

texts.zh-Hans: 一朵云跟了我一小段，我给它留了个口袋的位置。
texts.en: A cloud followed me for a while. I saved it a place in my pocket.

texts.zh-Hans: 我画了一块想打盹的路牌，箭头指向自己的枕头。
texts.en: I drew a sleepy sign. Its arrow pointed straight at its own pillow.

texts.zh-Hans: 捡到一颗圆纽扣，我先把它当作备用月亮。
texts.en: I found a round button and kept it as a spare moon.

texts.zh-Hans: 我和影子赛跑，转了个弯，它居然先到了。
texts.en: I raced my shadow. At the next corner, it got there first.

texts.zh-Hans: 今天的车票是我画的叶子，检票员也是我。
texts.en: My ticket today is a leaf I drew. I am also the ticket inspector.

texts.zh-Hans: 我给一只画出来的铃铛系上蝴蝶结，它安静得很有礼貌。
texts.en: I tied a bow on a bell I drew. It stayed politely quiet.

texts.zh-Hans: 我在纸上开了一扇小门，留给迟到的好主意。
texts.en: I drew a tiny door for good ideas that arrive late.

texts.zh-Hans: 帽檐下面新开了一个港口，只停纸船。
texts.en: A harbour opened under my hat brim. Paper boats only.

texts.zh-Hans: 我想给风写地址，信封上的字却先跑走了。
texts.en: I tried to address a letter to the wind. The words ran off first.

texts.zh-Hans: 我替一颗小石头挑了枕头，最后它选了另一颗石头。
texts.en: I picked a pillow for a pebble. It chose another pebble instead.

texts.zh-Hans: 把便签折成桥以后，铅笔终于能过河了。
texts.en: I folded a note into a bridge. My pencil could finally cross the river.

texts.zh-Hans: 我画了张面包屑地图，画到一半就想吃点心。
texts.en: I drew a map of crumbs. Halfway through, I wanted a snack.

texts.zh-Hans: 想象中的雨伞翻了个身，就成了我的小船。
texts.en: My imaginary umbrella turned upside down and became a little boat.

texts.zh-Hans: 我给箭头添了两只慢吞吞的脚，它说这样才看得清风景。
texts.en: I gave an arrow two slow feet. It said now it could enjoy the view.

texts.zh-Hans: 空信封鼓起了一角，我猜是昨晚画的星星还没睡醒。
texts.en: One corner of my envelope puffed up. Perhaps my drawn star was still asleep.

texts.zh-Hans: 一截线在桌上绕了三圈，我替它宣布旅途圆满。
texts.en: A thread made three loops on my desk. I declared its journey complete.

texts.zh-Hans: 我在纸上种了一盏灯，等天黑再看看它有没有发芽。
texts.en: I planted a lantern on paper. I will check for sprouts after dark.

texts.zh-Hans: 杯沿上新添了一个站台，乘客是两滴想象的雨。
texts.en: A station appeared on my cup rim. Two imaginary raindrops were waiting.

texts.zh-Hans: 我拉直一条丝带，替小纸船做了新的地平线。
texts.en: I stretched a ribbon into a new horizon for my paper boat.

texts.zh-Hans: 我画的隧道打了个哈欠，差点把出口也吞进去。
texts.en: The tunnel I drew yawned and nearly swallowed its own exit.

texts.zh-Hans: 如果有橡果那么小的行李箱，我只装一个好梦。
texts.en: If I had an acorn-sized suitcase, I would pack just one good dream.

texts.zh-Hans: 我给纸上的路添了脚印，现在它看起来没那么孤单了。
texts.en: I added footprints to a road on paper. It looked less lonely afterwards.

texts.zh-Hans: 我画了一碗指南针汤，勺子一直指向点心。
texts.en: I drew a bowl of compass soup. The spoon kept pointing towards snacks.

texts.zh-Hans: 我想给画里的云织围巾，第一针就绕到了天边。
texts.en: I tried knitting a scarf for a drawn cloud. The first stitch reached the horizon.

texts.zh-Hans: 我给画里的楼梯编了首歌，每一级只唱一个音。
texts.en: I made a song for a staircase I drew. Each step sang just one note.

texts.zh-Hans: 我在空白页上开了扇窗，窗外先画一小片海。
texts.en: I opened a window on a blank page and drew a little sea outside.

texts.zh-Hans: 我画了只背着灯笼的蜗牛，夜路忽然有了慢慢的亮光。
texts.en: I drew a snail carrying a lantern. The night road gained a slow little glow.

texts.zh-Hans: 我替纸风筝画了雨衣，结果它更想去天上走走了。
texts.en: I drew a raincoat for a paper kite. Now it wants to stroll through the sky.

texts.zh-Hans: 今天先在书签旁扎营，明天从没读完的那句话出发。
texts.en: Tonight I camp beside a bookmark. Tomorrow I will leave from the unfinished sentence.

texts.zh-Hans: 铅笔尖上亮起了想象的灯塔，给橡皮屑指路。
texts.en: An imaginary lighthouse lit up on my pencil tip to guide the eraser crumbs.

texts.zh-Hans: 我把一圈橙色画进信封，留作阴天的备用日出。
texts.en: I drew an orange circle inside an envelope: a spare sunrise for a grey day.

texts.zh-Hans: 折了一张小纸凳，正好让赶路的句号坐一会儿。
texts.en: I folded a paper bench so a travelling full stop could rest.

texts.zh-Hans: 我画的关卡只问一个问题：昨晚的梦带齐了吗？
texts.en: My drawn checkpoint asks just one question: did you pack all of last night’s dreams?

texts.zh-Hans: 尺子上的路太直了，我给它画了一个散步用的弯。
texts.en: The road on my ruler was too straight. I added a bend for taking walks.

texts.zh-Hans: 我给今天的悄悄话缝了个小袋，袋口留给明天的风。
texts.en: I sewed a bag for today’s whispers and left it open for tomorrow’s breeze.
